Callout.Name: Hunting After Dark
Callout.Message: Lamping reported in a field after dark.
Callout.Advisory: Two people on foot, rifles believed.

Script.Line: A lamp, in that field, for the last two hours.
Nobody is looking for anything legal at this hour.
There have been shots as well. Two of them.

Lines.Approach: They are lamping a field in the dark. Assume rifles and do not walk straight at them.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
